description.value:
Performance Practice operatives learned to fight the way they learned to dance, by feeling the rhythm of the moment and moving before conscious thought catches up. A blade or blaster is just another instrument, and combat itself becomes a routine to be performed flawlessly.

Audiences find them mesmerizing; opponents find them impossible to pin down. Every spin and step serves double duty, equally at home closing a show or closing the distance to a target's throat.
